Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Cars

汽车

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Did you enjoy traveling by car when you were a kid?

Yeah, I really did. As a kid I loved going on car trips, even short ones to the supermarket, because I could just sit back and watch the city go by. There was something exciting about being on the road.

小时候喜欢坐车出门，连去超市都兴奋，可以坐着看窗外街景。

Q2What types of cars do you like?

I'm really into SUVs, to be honest. They have plenty of space, which matters to me because I'm quite tall, and they're comfortable for long drives. A big interior makes the whole ride much more pleasant.

喜欢 SUV，空间大，我个子高坐着舒服，长途也舒适。

Q3Do you prefer to be a driver or a passenger?

Definitely a driver. I genuinely enjoy being behind the wheel and having control over the route, especially on roads I know well. As a passenger I get a bit restless, to be honest, because I can't do anything but wait.

更喜欢当司机，享受掌控方向盘和路线的乐趣，当乘客会觉得无聊。

Q4What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?

I just look out the window, honestly. I'd rather watch the street life, the shops and the people, than stare at my phone. It keeps me calm, and sometimes I even spot interesting little scenes.

堵车时就看窗外，看街景和行人而不刷手机，这样能保持平静。

Q5Do you think car colors are important?

Not really, no. To me, what matters is the performance, the comfort and the price, not the colour. I mean, white and black cars are everywhere anyway, so colour doesn't really stand out anymore.

颜色不重要，性能、舒适度和价格才重要，满大街黑白车，颜色不突出。
